tracks.title: My Truck Has Better Wi-Fi Than You
tracks.prompt: Original comedic country-rock song with believable warm male country baritone, relaxed Southern delivery, natural phrasing, slight gravel, acoustic guitar, bright electric guitar, bass, live drums, light fiddle, playful harmonies, polished radio-ready production and a huge singalong chorus. Human-sounding breath and timing. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I got a dent in the tailgate,
Mud up past the doors,
Coffee in the cupholder,
And a socket set on the floor.

She's twenty years of trouble,
With three hundred thousand miles,
But there's a router underneath the seat
That'll reach you half a mile.

[Pre-Chorus]
You pulled up in that fancy thing,
Said, "Man, what can she do?"

I said, "She leaks a little oil...
But she'll download faster than you."

[Chorus]
My truck's got better Wi-Fi than you,
Five bars flying down Route 2.
She ain't got leather, ain't got lane assist,
But buddy, she don't buffer like this.

You can laugh at the rust,
You can laugh at the view,
But when your little spinning circle starts—
My truck's got better Wi-Fi than you.

[Verse 2]
JakeAI's riding shotgun,
Giving questionable advice.

Said, "Your check-engine light is currently—"
I said, "Yeah, it's been on twice."

It said, "Perhaps we should repair it."
I said, "Perhaps you oughta hush."

Then the radio played a country song
Written by the thing I just cussed.

[Final Chorus]
My truck's got better Wi-Fi than you,
Still starts up on attempt number two.

She's got duct tape, rust
And an AI too—
Buddy, welcome to the future.

We ain't got a clue.

[Spoken Outro]
AI: Your vehicle requires immediate maintenance.
DRIVER: Play another song.
AI: Playing another song.

tracks.title: Build While They Sleep
tracks.prompt: Original cinematic electronic synthwave and hip-hop song with a distinct synthetic female-to-androgynous lead vocalist, cool restrained verses, clear diction, intimate close-mic tone, deep sub bass, crisp modern drums, dark arpeggiated synths, wide pads, glitch accents and a powerful layered chorus. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Lights down
Screens awake
One more run
One more mistake

[Verse 1]
Quiet room, city gone black
Half-built future staring back
No applause, no finish line
Just a blinking cursor keeping time

I don't need the room to know
I don't need the green light glow
Small idea, heavy steel
Make it work and make it real

[Pre-Chorus]
Everybody loves the sunrise
Nobody asks who wired the street

[Chorus]
Build while they sleep
Keep the signal underneath
Turn the maybe into motion
Turn the noise into a beat
Build while they sleep
No permission, no parade
When the morning finds the doorway
It was already made

[Verse 2]
Coffee cold, fan spins slow
Three bad versions, one good go
Every failure leaves a mark
Every working thing began in dark

[Bridge]
No spotlight
No speech
Just one more thing
Within reach

[Final Chorus]
Build while they sleep
Keep the signal underneath
Turn the maybe into motion
Turn the noise into a beat
Build while they sleep
No permission, no parade
When the morning finds the doorway
It was already made

[Outro]
Screens dim
Daylight leaks
Leave the machine running
Let it speak

tracks.title: Still Building
tracks.prompt: Original hard rock song with a convincing male rock tenor, controlled rasp, two electric guitars, bass, live drums and occasional analog synth texture. Energetic but not screamed. Strong chorus doubles and believable live-band phrasing. No imitation of any named band or vocalist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lights are on in the back room
Somebody left the plans awake
One more bolt, one more bad idea
One more thing we had to make

The floor is marked with footprints
The clock forgot to care
If tomorrow wants an answer
Tell it we're still under there

[Pre-Chorus]
No ribbon
No parade
No committee ever stayed this late

[Chorus]
Still building
Still making sparks
Still finding doors
In rooms that started dark
No promise that it's pretty
No guarantee we win
We're still building
So don't come in

[Verse 2]
Every clean machine has fingerprints
Every shortcut leaves a sound
Every problem gets more confident
The longer no one's around

We learned to trust the warning light
Right after ignoring three
If the future wants an appointment
It can wait outside with me

[Bridge]
Hammer down
Power on
Something's wrong
Keep moving on

[Final Chorus]
Still building
Still making sparks
Still finding doors
In rooms that started dark
No promise that it's pretty
No guarantee we win
We're still building
So don't come in

Continuing

[Verse 1]

I went ahead

Error

tracks.title: No Signal After Midnight
tracks.prompt: Original late-night alternative dream-pop song with believable intimate female alto, soft breathy edges, restrained live drums, warm bass guitar, chiming guitar, analog synths, ambient texture and tasteful layered harmonies. Slightly strange but emotionally human. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Streetlights count the empty cars
Blue glow fading through the bars
Someone left a message blinking
No one here is in a hurry

Elevators hum alone
Every floor looks like a phone
Rain keeps drawing little circuits
On the windows of the city

[Chorus]
No signal after midnight
No reason to explain
The city keeps on breathing
Through the static and the rain
No signal after midnight
But something still gets through
Maybe silence has a frequency
And maybe it found you

[Verse 2]
Coffee cooling by the screen
Numbers blur to shades of green
Somewhere far across the rooftops
One red light refuses sleeping

I don't need to know the answer
I don't need the map tonight
If the signal never finds us
We can still follow the light

[Final Chorus]
No signal after midnight
No reason to explain
The city keeps on breathing
Through the static and the rain
No signal after midnight
But something still gets through
Maybe silence has a frequency
And maybe it found you
